channel.title: Coding From Zero
channel.description: Learning to code from the very first line.

item.title: Python Dictionaries Explained With Simple Examples
item.description: A beginner guide to Python dictionaries, covering keys and values, adding and deleting items, get() versus KeyError, looping, and counting things.

item.title: Python Lists for Beginners, Create, Index, Slice, and Change
item.description: How Python lists work for beginners, including indexing, slicing, adding and removing items, sorting, and the copy mistake that surprises everyone.

item.title: How to Read a Python Error Message
item.description: A guide to understanding Python tracebacks and the most common beginner errors, with tested examples from the official Python documentation.

item.title: Python Loops, For vs While, With Examples You Can Run
item.description: A beginner's guide to Python's for and while loops, including break, continue, and the loop else clause, with every example runnable in python3.

item.title: Variables and Data Types in Python, Explained Simply
item.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Python variables and basic data types, with runnable examples based on the official Python tutorial.

item.title: Writing Your First Python Script with Functions
item.description: A beginner walkthrough of turning interactive Python code into a reusable script, using the official Python tutorial's own module example.
